# One case of place_job, on Maya's rooftop-garden app.
case	Maya's machines are off and Tenki's runners were never installed here, so GitHub takes it
places	order=own,tenki,github wait=10
job	linux	pr	self-hosted,linux,pr
keep	on
queued	0
gone	no
now	1793000000
runner	offline	false	self-hosted,linux,pr
runner	offline	false	self-hosted,linux
expect	github	ubuntu-latest	no	offline	own:offline,tenki:not-connected
words	Your machine was offline, so this ran on GitHub.
